name: johnny5
about: Johnny 5: a comic page, his head struck by lightning, ZZZAP!, NEED INPUT!, then arms up under NUMBER 5 IS ALIVE!

licence.assets: CC BY-SA 4.0. kiosk/art/johnny5.png (arms down), johnny5-arms-up.png and johnny5-head.png are Muse's pixel art; johnny5-strike.png is Nula's art after Muse's; all made after "204 MNACTEC (Terrassa), exposició temporal Robots, Johnny 5, de Short Circuit (1986).jpg" by Enric (Wikimedia Commons, CC BY-SA 4.0), and reduced here (cut out, 20 or 19 colours from the art itself, ink outlines). Johnny-5 is Short Circuit's (1986) design: an unofficial fan tribute, for our own kiosks
